
The current development build has one project engine, used from R or the local
browser. Starting from raw counts, it pauses for the initial strategy, measured
clustering and annotation. Save edits, inspect the resulting snapshot, then
approve each scientific decision separately. Opening a project does not run it.

## Offline public software control

```{r public-control}
library(scAgentKit)
source(system.file("examples","three-gate-analysis.R",package="scAgentKit"))
checked <- three_gate_analysis(tempfile("pbmc-three-gates-"))
checked$receipt
```

This helper explicitly approves a **public fixture only**: SeuratObject's
`pbmc_small` (230 genes, 80 cells), ordinary resolution scan retained, limited
PCs/HVGs and Unknown labels. It makes no model request. Its receipt requires
three actual approvals and unchanged input; it does not validate biology or
supply study parameters. Chunks are not evaluated during vignette build because
scientific approval for a real dataset belongs to the researcher; the separate
regression and installed-package acceptance execute this public helper.

## Your study

```{r study}
project <- sc_analyze("counts.rds","new-study-project",
  context=list(species="human",tissue="Actual tissue",research_goal="Actual question"))
initial <- sc_review(project)
# Inspect QC/retention and the complete plan before deciding.
measured <- sc_review(initial,"approve",reviewer="analyst",
  reason="Explain the reviewed initial plan.",continue=TRUE)
measured <- sc_review(measured)
measured$view$strategy_review$details$cluster_diagnostics
# Inspect actual PCs, resolution scan/tree, marker contrasts and sample composition.
annotation <- sc_review(measured,"approve",reviewer="analyst",
  reason="Explain the measured clustering choice.",continue=TRUE)
# Complete annotation$annotations with labels/Unknown, confidence, reasons and citations.
# Revise, inspect the full proposal, then approve separately; see the R protocol.
```

Choose manual versus immutable configured-model initialization before creating a
project. Model payload consent is separate from scientific approval. Inputs are
not reinterpreted as donor/capture/batch based on names. `sc_result()` returns a
Seurat; marker/reference utilities return tables and plot utilities return paths.
There is no AgentSeurat analysis pipeline or automatic hybrid-score writeback.
See `vignette("scAgentKit-pbmc_small")`, package help and the repository R protocol
for the complete annotation and reopening steps.
